result.question: What happens when Gaal fights Abimelech?

readings.answer: Abimelech pursues him, and Gaal flees.
readings.support: Abimelech pursued him, | Gaal fled before him.

readings.answer: Zebul drives Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
readings.support: Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.

assessments.reason: Verse 9:40 states “Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him,” matching the key’s “Gaal flees.”
The text says “many Shechemites fell wounded,” which supports many casualties; this is a weaker phrasing than the key’s “many die” but fits the same outcome theme.
“Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem” (9:41) is a subsequent action and not the fight’s immediate outcome summarized by the key.
